channel.title: Wire — Security
channel.description: Security from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: TCP Use-After-Free: CVE-2026-98432 / CVSS 9.8
item.description: CVE-2026-98432 is a CVSS 9.8 remote use-after-free in Linux's IPv4 TCP handshake, fixed upstream Oct 15. Ubuntu and RHEL haven't shipped a fixed kernel yet. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Malware uses LLMs to rank victims by how much they're worth
item.description: The self-deleting VOLTA infostealer steals credentials, sessions, and cryptocurrency wallets. Then, it uses LLMs to profile victims and rank their most valuable assets. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Cloudflare’s Post-Quantum GeoKey Manager Enters Closed Beta Without Attribute-Based Encryption
item.description: Cloudflare has moved a post-quantum rebuild of GeoKey Manager into closed beta, guarding geo-fenced keys with hybrid ML-KEM-768 and X25519 instead of the attribute-based encryption used since 2022. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: OpenBSD 8.0 Brings Expanded Hardware Support, Security Enhancements, and Virtualization Improvements
item.description: OpenBSD 8.0 is a substantial upgrade bringing broader hardware compatibility, enhanced security, an expanded virtual address space, and support for modern architectures, including Intel Arc A-Series graphics support, ARM64 hibernation,… (1 source: infoq)
